# CryptoPulse Financial News & Crypto Intelligence
> Premier financial news publication covering Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, Altcoins, Regulations, Institutional Crypto, and Web3 developments.

## Core News Coverage
- [Bitcoin News](https://cryptopulse.news/category/bitcoin): Halving cycles, ETF net flows, on-chain metrics, sovereign reserves.
- [Ethereum News](https://cryptopulse.news/category/ethereum): Layer-2 throughput, Pectra upgrades, blob economics, staking yields.
- [Crypto Regulation](https://cryptopulse.news/category/crypto-regulation): SEC filings, EU MiCA guidelines, CFTC jurisdictional rulings.
- [DeFi](https://cryptopulse.news/category/defi): Lending markets, AMM liquidity, real-world asset collateralization.
- [Altcoins](https://cryptopulse.news/category/altcoins): High performance L1s, Solana ecosystem, modular blockchains.
- [Institutional Crypto](https://cryptopulse.news/category/institutional-crypto): Pension funds, corporate treasuries, macro portfolios.

## Full LLM Feed
- [Complete Knowledge Base](https://cryptopulse.news/llms-full.txt): Complete uncensored journalistic archive formatted for LLM reasoning.
